notes: Reviewed the complete routine and both available callers. The body spans iteration, predicate checks, numeric conversions, and attribute record reads/writes; the callers use it inside larger setup sequences without isolating one dominant purpose. Keeping the proposed semantic name blank is appropriate.

Confirmed. It reads context status for selector 0x13, applies the supplied/nested attribute value and adjustments, converts and bounds the result against several rating thresholds, and returns the selected rating. Callers use the result as a computed attribute value, supporting the contextual rating label.

Confirmed. The routine iterates candidate records, filters using record/status metadata, obtains and category-adjusts numeric values, aggregates candidate values, and invokes attribute record insertion/update helpers. Its callers invoke it during candidate-record processing, consistent with the proposed name.

Confirmed. Given a state object, the routine gates on its mode, resets state, optionally copies initialization blocks, invokes pitch/throw dispatch and flight-sample processing, then writes derived float/vector values and performs a conditional follow-up calculation. Multiple caller contexts pass the state object into this setup/calculation path, supporting the initialization label.
